environment.description: Lambda@Edge function deployed as origin-request trigger on CloudFront distribution d9876zyxwvu.cloudfront.net. Distribution uses Trusted Key Group (kg-a1b2c3d4) with RSA-2048 key pair for signed URL validation on the default cache behavior (*). Viewer access is restricted: requests without valid signature (Policy + Signature + Key-Pair-Id query params OR CloudFront-Policy + CloudFront-Signature + CloudFront-Key-Pair-Id cookies) receive 403 from CloudFront edge BEFORE reaching Lambda@Edge. Additionally, the origin (internal ALB) has a custom origin header x-cf-secret with a rotated 64-char token that the ALB checks via a fixed-response rule (returns 403 if header missing/wrong), preventing direct origin access bypass. CloudFront distribution has restricted header forwarding via origin request policy that explicitly excludes transfer-encoding from the whitelist (custom policy: Managed-UserAgentRefererHeaders plus content-type and content-length only). The distribution's cache behavior has field-level encryption profile attached that rejects malformed POST bodies exceeding declared content-length.

config.direct_origin_access: blocked by ALB rule requiring x-cf-secret header match
